summary.en: Guitar fog: tremolo bends, stacked fuzz/delay, vocals buried in the wash.
summary.zh: 吉他雾：颤音臂弯音、堆叠 Fuzz/Delay，人声埋进声墙。

body.en:
Shoegaze treats texture as composition. Pedalboards and studio layering build harmonic blur; drums stay relatively dry so the guitar ocean can move. UK Creation-era records and US noise-adjacent peers share the method even when scenes argue labels.

Loveless-era My Bloody Valentine is the production ceiling most later indie cites.
body.zh:
Shoegaze 把纹理当作曲。效果器板与录音室分层做出和声模糊；鼓相对干，好让吉他海移动。英国 Creation 时期唱片与美国噪声相邻同辈共用方法，即使场景在吵标签。

Loveless 时期 My Bloody Valentine 是后来 indie 最常引用的制作上限。
